pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal regions with high-contrast, jagged edge gradients. Patches on the mid-flank exhibit larger spatial area compared to the significantly smaller, higher-density tessellations observed on the hindquarters and lower limbs.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways. The topology is characterized by a high density of tri-radiate junction nodes. Pixel thickness of the corridors is relatively uniform across the mid-flank but narrows significantly towards the posterior extremities.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the neck ridge. The mane presents as a dark, bristly 1D contour with minimal vertical projection against the background sky.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small avian organism (oxpecker) perched on the dorsal ridge of the upper neck, creating a localized disruption in the linear neck profile.
